text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
You are quite skilled at crane games—
I am truly impressed.
choice_data_list: Still, maybe I took a bit too much...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
No... I'm just really—looking forward to
displaying it in my room alongside some flowers.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Should the flowers match the impression of her face...?
Or maybe they should match the color of her tail after all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Giving it a gorgeous look could work—
No, gathering plenty of small flowers nearby to give it a delicate charm might surely...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"And then—ah, I'm sorry...
I got carried away all by myself—"
choice_data_list: I'm so glad Bouquet looks like she's having fun
